origin: Publicly served PDF documents from PJM and Dominion Energy investor relations. No login, paywall or request form was bypassed.
authorization: Author asked on 2026-09-21 for a graphic from SemiAnalysis or PJM for the Chapter 17 Dominion slide. No public SemiAnalysis figure shows Dominion's contract stages.

assets.title: Transmission Zones map (PDF title 20230511_PJM Zone Map)
assets.modifications: Vector PDF rendered at 400 dpi; cropped to the map above the legend box, removing the page margin, legend, PJM logo and date stamp; resampled to 2200 px wide. Zone colours, boundaries and labels unchanged.
limitations: A zone is not a company: the Dominion zone also contains NOVEC, ODEC members and Rappahannock Electric Cooperative.
Dated May 2023; still PJM's posted zone map on the retrieval date. The crop removes the visible date, so the slide credit carries it.

assets.title: Q2 2026 earnings call slides, slide 5: Dominion Energy Virginia data center contracted capacity (updated)
assets.data_date: July 2023, December 2025, March 2026 and July 2026 contract snapshots
assets.modifications: Whole slide rendered from PDF page 5 at 300 dpi, uncropped, then resampled to 2400 px wide. Content unchanged.
limitations: Contracted capacity only; it does not show demand. The 2025 coincident peak of about 4 GW is from Dominion's January 6, 2026 letter to PJM (P233).
SELOA on this slide is the stage the January 2026 letter calls ELOA.
Movement between stages across dates is not a measured conversion or cancellation rate.
Scope is Dominion Energy Virginia customers, not the whole Dominion zone or PJM. Copyrighted investor material; keep the credit and source link on the slide.
